guards.what: CrueltyPower.cs:17 ModifyVulnerableMultiplier is NOT a hook
guards.rationale: It is `public decimal`, not `public override`, so the harness enumerates no hook for it and there is no dispatcher: VulnerablePower calls it directly off `dealer.GetPower<CrueltyPower>()` (VulnerablePower.cs:35-39). The sim reproduces exactly that shape -- CrueltyPower's class body is passive (powers.py:651-659) and VulnerablePower reads `dealer.powers.get('cruelty')` inline (powers.py:414-416). Faithful, and this is why the unit's hook list is only the two declaration properties.

guards.issue: Cruelty's self-exclusion is dropped by its consumer. Recorded in full on power/vulnerable's matching guard -- the sim reads Cruelty's amount with no such test, so a Cruelty holder attacking its own Vulnerable self would get the bonus in the sim and not in the game. Per binding rule 3 the same mechanism carries the same verdict at both records, and it is DORMANT for the same executed reason: no ported effect deals POWERED attack damage from a creature to itself (the self-damage sites all pass NON_CARD_HP_LOSS, which is UNPOWERED and never reaches the multiplicative family, cmds.py:56). Carried here as well as on power/vulnerable because it is Cruelty's own guard and a reader of cruelty.json must not conclude the unit is clean.
